Docs/Citation

Citation

Cite the 2026 DexArena arXiv preprint and identify the benchmark and artifacts used in your experiment.

The benchmark reference

Cite DexArena when using its task definitions, demonstrations, evaluation protocol or reported results. The supplied paper record is a 2026 arXiv preprint, identified by arXiv:2611.02629.

Haonan Ping, Jianshu Hu, Yimin Wang, Yi Zhu, Pai Liang, Qiyan Jin, Qirui Bao, Ying Qian, Xinyang Ding, Hongfei Qiao, Tianle Xue, Yucheng Bai, Soo Wei Jie, Shuguang Li, Yutong Ban. (2026). DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation. arXiv preprint arXiv:2611.02629. https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.02629 ↗.

Open arXiv record ↗ · Read PDF ↗ · Official repository ↗

Copy the BibTeX entry

This entry follows the paper title and supplied author order. It cites the preprint; it does not assert a conference or journal publication.

Download .bib ↓

  title = {DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation},
  author = {Haonan Ping and Jianshu Hu and Yimin Wang and Yi Zhu and Pai Liang and Qiyan Jin and Qirui Bao and Ying Qian and Xinyang Ding and Hongfei Qiao and Tianle Xue and Yucheng Bai and Soo Wei Jie and Shuguang Li and Yutong Ban},

}

Identify the version behind a result

Alongside the citation, record the arXiv version you consulted and the exact environment/source revision used for your experiment. For a dataset or checkpoint, preserve its own identity, revision and access information when available. The public repository currently contains project information and a license; it does not yet supply the executable research modules or dataset/checkpoint downloads.

A methods section should state the evaluated track, task list, embodiment, camera/observation contract, episode count, seed manifest and any changes to the benchmark. For a long-horizon experiment, describe how stage transitions are handled without intermediate simulator resets.

Credit the methods you use

The DexArena citation credits the benchmark. Cite the original learning algorithms and model releases relevant to your implementation as well. The training guide links to the primary sources for PPO, RLPD, ACT, Diffusion Policy, GR00T and π0.5 and separates original methods from DexArena-specific adaptations.

For reporting details, follow the score protocol and the reproduction checklist.
